notes.page_content: Underlined Cas particuliers. A corrected supposition and two closure equalities; a further Sigma_12 equality; a separator; a slanted partition note; a J subset I paragraph, partition display and lower partition prose ending Pour.
notes.author_own_uncertainty_note: No explicit author doubt word or question mark was identified. Editorial unsure markings are reader uncertainty.

notes.page_counts: Archive pencil 16 at lower left; no author page number is supplied. H page 16 is the witness page identifier, one below our scan.
notes.mathematics_led_reading_decisions: No algebraic, topological or theorem check was performed. The written X setminus Sigma_i is retained. The dot-like mark and slashed form receive no inferred mathematical role. Formula expectations did not settle uncertain strokes.
notes.witness_apparatus: H note about X setminus Sigma_i is editorial apparatus, not extra manuscript text. H emph matches the observed title underline. H sqcup and C amalg at the two inspected square joins convey the same selected glyph; that macro conversion creates no row. H page macro is pagination apparatus.
notes.graphic_placement: All graphical paths are manual approximations of observed strokes. Literal full-scan coordinates are translated by the declared fixed local origins. Text nodes use base-west anchors and zero inner/outer separation; their font extents are not claimed to be original pixel bounds. G03 has only a local upright shape origin and the full source-locus box because its attachment remains unresolved.
notes.crop_limits: Crop02 clips the top of the contextual initial A, but retains the trouve target and the complete que descender. Crop03 includes the continuation of that descender at its top. Crop09 clips unrelated upper/side context, with the ternaires target and full guide preserved. Crop18 clips part of the following les context, with definies complete. No target was recropped or reopened.
notes.final_joint_read: Two combined TeX/report outputs were truncated by tool delivery. The complete TeX was visible; the complete report is read across smaller field groups, including the previously omitted middle. No image is reopened.
